name: mermaid-block
title: Mermaid Block
description: A mermaid diagram drawn in the browser — the engine loaded lazily, the configuration pinned (strict security, SVG labels, dagre), token colours in light and dark, the last diagram that worked kept on an error — plus the ready blockViews entry for TextEdit and MarkdownView.

meta.whenToUse: Diagrams written as ```mermaid fences — in a TextEdit or MarkdownView (blockViews={{ mermaid: mermaidBlockView }}) or on their own (MermaidBlock, renderMermaid).
meta.whenNotToUse: Charts of data (Chart), or an image someone uploaded (FileViewer).
